page.layout: One page of a table: three columns read from left to right. Left column, words (Bes, Septunx, Semis, Quicunx, Triens, Quadrans). Middle column, numbers (40 down to 12). Right column, fractions stacked vertically, one beside each row. Faint show-through of a header from the reverse side at the top, not transcribed.
page.notes: The right-hand fractions are printed as stacked numerals with a bar; their pairing with the rows is read from the values (40 = 2/3 of 60, 38 = 19/30, and so on). The entry for 18 (3/10) is doubtful in the scan. Faint show-through of the reverse page's header appears at the top and is not transcribed. The watermark URL at the foot is not part of the page.
